primaryCorroboration.provenance: Parent official primary review corroborates pinned PHB165 fixed5; no PHB175 book node is used as Alert source

boundaries: Fixed5 is a separate initiative component after finalDEX and before legacy absolute override; sheetinitiative offsets still apply after the manual total. No manual values are rewritten or subtracted.
Alert owns no ability cap event. Genuine XPHB Origin PB/swap behavior remains exactly prebatch, not a PHB fixed5 alias.
Source/automation/level restriction preserves intent/resources; explicit clear/replace/withdraw removes current-domain intent. Duplicate/stale/forged source claims are never repaired automatically.
All exact source clauses and modern entry-list hash are authenticated without distributing publisher prose. Surprise and unseen-attacker conditions remain manual.

Actual8e48 preserves unknown intent, but clear/reselect/manual edits may retain stale review and downgrade loses source identity; safeEditingCompatibility=false. Use supporting-client withdrawal/review/reconfirmation.
